instruction: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\FULLADD.DSN` is the built-in two-level hierarchical full-adder example from OrCAD Capture. Extract its flattened structural information and write `C:\Users\user\Desktop\flat.json` with these fields: - `root_schematic`: the name of the root schematic. - `total_primitive_parts`: the total number of primitive part instances after recursively expanding the hierarchy. Hierarchical blocks themselves do not count. Each child schematic contributes once per instance. - `hier_block_expansions`: an array of objects of the form `{"parent": <parent_schematic>, "ref": <inst_refdes>, "child": <referenced_schematic>}` listing every hierarchical-block instance referenced from a schematic. Order is arbitrary. Do not modify `C:\Users\user\Desktop\FULLADD.DSN`; only generate `C:\Users\user\Desktop\flat.json`. [Software] Use OrCAD's native Capture design converter `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\cap2xml.exe`. On this machine, use `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe` for OrCAD schematics and `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\allegro.exe` for board work.
